steps.what: Monitor sanitation practices and correct departures from standards and regulations

tasks.design: Keep sanitation standards available in {DOCS} and retain direct observation of kitchen practice. Existing temperature or hygiene records can support checks, but they do not establish that employees follow safe practices during service.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sanitation failures are often visible in actions and context rather than a complete sensor reading.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records help supervision without replacing direct monitoring.
tasks.still_hard: Cross-contamination, poor hand hygiene and shortcuts under time pressure.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising unsafe behaviour and intervening promptly.
tasks.altitude: No change to sanitation accountability or direct observation time.

reach.learn: Distinguish missing records from unsafe practice

evidence.claim: Digital records or waste capture do not establish automated observation of employee sanitation practices; no labour saving is claimed.

assumptions: Boundary is live sanitation monitoring and immediate correction, not separate temperature-log transcription or production reporting. Staff corrective work remains outside the chef denominator and unchanged.
No machine consumes an assumed compliance flag. Chef observation and interpretation retain all100 hours.
Native standards and records are used first. Zero upkeep because no sensor, surveillance system or new process is introduced.
unknowns: Existing sanitation checks and kitchen hazards
research_questions: Which unsafe practices remain invisible in the existing hygiene records?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives net0 after zero upkeep. Live monitoring remains; no separate log-entry saving is imported.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Instruct cooks through demonstrations and feedback on preparation, cooking, garnishing and presentation

tasks.design: Make approved recipe and presentation references available in {DOCS}. Keep demonstrations, tasting, observation and feedback with the chef; a recipe card does not establish practical skill.
tasks.previous_blocker: Food preparation requires sensory judgement and correction of physical technique.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing references can support instruction without replacing demonstration.
tasks.still_hard: Differences in ingredients, timing, equipment and staff experience.
tasks.human_edge: Showing a technique and explaining why the result needs adjustment.
tasks.altitude: Practical teaching responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Observable outcomes and safe working methods

evidence.claim: Recipe cost calculation and sales forecasting do not establish a labour saving for hands-on cooking instruction.

assumptions: Boundary is live teaching and feedback, not recipe development or training-material authoring. Learner time stays outside the chef denominator and unchanged.
No machine relies on an assumed skill or doneness code. The chef interprets staff practice during s1 with full time retained.
Native recipe access comes first. Zero upkeep because no new training system or materials are proposed.
unknowns: Staff experience and existing recipe references
research_questions: Which preparation errors need sensory demonstration rather than written instructions?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives net0 after zero upkeep. Teaching retains full time; no assumed course-authoring fraction is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Supervise and coordinate cooks' activities as orders, timing and kitchen conditions change

tasks.design: Use existing kitchen order displays in {OPS_SYSTEM} where already installed. Keep live coordination and intervention with the chef; existing ticket routing is not counted as a new reduction in supervision effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation priorities change with station delays, staff questions and the condition of food.
tasks.enabler_now: Order visibility supports coordination without resolving every service conflict.
tasks.still_hard: Synchronising dishes and reallocating work without compromising safety or quality.
tasks.human_edge: Reading the kitchen and giving timely, workable instructions.
tasks.altitude: Live service leadership stays with the chef.

reach.learn: Communicate delays and guest needs without disrupting kitchen flow

evidence.claim: Tenzo supports sales forecasting and manager adjustment; that does not establish replacement of live kitchen coordination.

assumptions: Boundary is live kitchen work coordination. Staffing forecasts, rota production, sanitation monitoring and technique instruction are distinct tasks; do not add the same intervention twice in a roll-up.
No new machine consumes assumed station-ready or sold-out flags. Existing order entry is an unchanged upstream process and earns no chef labour saving.
Test native order visibility first. Zero upkeep because the existing service coordination process is unchanged; no automated staff allocation or scoring is proposed.
unknowns: Existing order display and division of service responsibilities
research_questions: Which service bottlenecks require a chef's judgement despite complete ticket visibility?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, net0 after zero upkeep. Existing order-display runtime earns no saving; chef coordination time remains fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check stock and service needs to choose food and supply order quantities
Assemble the food order or requisition from the chosen supply lines
Check and submit the final supply order through the authorised purchasing route

tasks.design: Configure saved supplier lines and quantity reuse in {PROCUREMENT} before custom development. The chef still checks stock, decides quantities and approves the final order; plain code assembles those chosen lines without guessing stock, spoilage or substitutions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Chosen quantities may be recopied into supplier orders or internal requisitions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing purchasing configuration can reuse stable catalogue lines and entered quantities.
tasks.still_hard: Perishability, pack sizes, supplier substitutions and changes in service demand.
tasks.human_edge: Balancing fresh stock, service needs and waste risk.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated order assembly when it exists; chef purchasing decisions stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Pack conversions, substitution controls and delivery cutoffs

evidence.claim: Apicbase rolls supplier ingredient prices into recipe cost; this supports availability of linked price data, not the particular order-assembly saving proposed here.
Saved-line order assembly and the35-hour removable duplication fraction are model-knowledge scenarios, not a measured restaurant result.

assumptions: Boundary covers stock-informed order quantities, assembly and submission, not meal-demand forecasting, receiving goods or invoice processing. Already automatic ordering earns no new saving.

Chef produces item or checked catalogue ID, supplier ID, quantity, unit/pack size, delivery site and required date in s1, with all45 hours retained including capture. Catalogue suppliers produce current pack and price data in their existing catalogue process; chef verifies the selected mapping in s1. Missing or changed lines are manually assembled and checked; no free par level, stock balance or spoilage code is assumed.

s2 only assembles the exact lines produced by s1. It cannot choose replacements or quantities. s3 retains20 hours for prices, pack conversions, total, delivery and delegated authority checks; changes void approval.

Native purchasing functions come first. Incremental5 focal hours cover catalogue/pack exceptions and rule checks;2 purchasing-role hours cover supplier mapping upkeep. Supplier fulfilment time is unchanged and outside this denominator.
unknowns: Actual repeated ordering effort and existing catalogue integration
Chef purchasing authority and supplier data quality
research_questions: Can selected quantities reach the supplier order without re-entry or more stock-capture effort?

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier, items, quantities, pack units, prices, delivery details and total; changes void chef approval
